movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Loose, rhythmic movements that suggest a lack of rigid control.
movement_profile.footwork: Heel-pivoting technique where the front foot turns inward and the back foot turns backward.

signature_moves.description: A forward or backward walking motion using the heel as a pivot to create a sliding effect.
signature_moves.name: Heel-pivot walk

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by the high-energy pulse of psy trance and electro house, providing a steady, driving beat for the dancer.

basic_steps: Use the heel as a pivot point.
Turn the back foot backwards while the front foot turns inwards around the heel.
Repeat the movement in reverse to travel backwards.
